$comment: Colour language gate rules CL1-CL7 (PROPOSAL-color-language.md section 7). A component id in 'migrated' makes CL2-CL6 blocking for it; an id in 'slotOnlyBlocking' makes CL1 blocking for it. '*' means every component. Add a batch's ids when that batch is migrated. CL7 (slot contrast pairs) is foundation-wide and blocks only when 'contrastBlocking' is true. All 158 components were migrated on 2026-10-25, so CL1-CL6 block everywhere ('*').

literalColorAllow.$comment: colourMath: component code that computes colours (hsl()/oklch() ramps, color-mix of user paint). contentFixtures: fixtures whose literal colours are user content (swatches, themes, images, artwork), not UI chrome.

designAllow.$comment: Owner-approved design exceptions to a CL rule (owner, 2026-10-25: follow the design and update or ignore the gate; never bend the design to the gate). rule -> component id -> reason. Hits stay visible as warnings.

CL3.resize-handle: The 2px hover line appears from nothing (transparent -> accent solid). It is an affordance mark, not a fill changing emphasis.
CL3.position-size: Hover and pressed take the opaque interaction fills over the tint field (owner 2026-10-26: no translucent backgrounds, the old wash becomes neutral-hover / neutral-pressed). Same steady emphasis, now opaque.

designOverContrast.$comment: Owner-approved design over contrast: axe colour-contrast on these slots is a G3 warning, not blocking. component id -> data-slot names + reason.

menu.reason: Selected rows keep tertiary meta text on the neutral selected fill as designed (owner, 2026-10-25: design over gate); dark mode measures below 4.5:1.

combobox.reason: Selected rows keep tertiary meta text on the neutral selected fill as designed (owner, 2026-10-25: design over gate); dark mode measures below 4.5:1.

stack-row.reason: A hidden layer row takes the disabled colour (PROPOSAL A9), which measures below 4.5:1; owner, 2026-10-25: design over gate.

radio-group.reason: A disabled option's label takes disabled.text (PROPOSAL §2: disabled is a colour, the tone drops out); WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls. Owner, 2026-10-25: design over gate.

card-stat.reason: The delta is text-only in the tone graphic colour, lighter than the text step, as the owner asked (2026-10-27: "텍스트 색을 더 밝은걸로"); light mode measures below 4.5:1.

plan.reason: Done steps are dimmed one step past tertiary (text.placeholder) as the owner asked (2026-10-28: "한단계 더 흐리게"); dark agent soft measures below 4.5:1.

property-stack.reason: Hidden paint layers are StackRow hidden rows (PROPOSAL A9, disabled colour); owner, 2026-10-25: design over gate.

chip.reason: Status chips keep their tone text on the soft hover and pressed fills; light success, danger and info text measure 4.0–4.4:1 there, which tokens accept as design-over-contrast warnings.

color-tile.reason: The audit mark keeps success/danger text on neutral.track; light success.text measures under 4.5:1 there, a token-level design-over-contrast warning.

contrast-insight.reason: The " : 1" unit takes the status text colour of the best result on the neutral.track readout (owner 2026-10-27, proposal A); warning.text in light measures under 4.5:1.

choice-group.reason: selectedFill="solid" keeps paper text on neutral.solid as the owner chose (2026-10-28, choice-cards option E, light-oriented); dark mode measures about 2:1.
